piotr-borowiecki.role: Founder of SaaSy Land · Full-stack software engineer
piotr-borowiecki.bio: Piotr is a full-stack software engineer working on payments systems (ISO 20022) and the founder of SaaSy Land, where he builds the starter kit and writes about shipping production SaaS with TypeScript, React and Cloudflare. BSc (Hons) Computer Science, Durham University.

cta.label: SaaSy Land
cta.title: The SaaS foundation your AI agent can’t break.
cta.body: Auth on your own database, email, an admin console and {languages, plural, one {# locale} other {# locales}}, live in this site’s public source today. Strict types, lint rules and a {coverageThreshold, number}% coverage gate fail any pull request that breaks them, and an AGENTS.md tells your agent the rules. {generation, select, available {{initCommand} writes it as plain code in the stack you choose, starting with the options in the configurator.} other {Once project generation arrives, the CLI writes it as plain code in the stack you choose.}}

rows.toolchain: Toolchain: formatter, type-aware lint, Git hooks, commit messages, Vitest projects and Playwright
rows.worker: Worker entry: locale redirects, security headers, HTML rewriting, prerendering and the Wrangler environments
rows.database: Cloudflare D1 with Drizzle, migrations, and a test database with its seed
rows.deploy: Deploy scripts that check bindings, prepare secrets, migrate and verify the live site
rows.i18n: Internationalization: locale routing, formatters and the checks that fail CI on a missing or broken translation
rows.translations: The interface translated into every supported language
rows.interface: UI kit, app shell, themes, a skeleton for every route and one data table
rows.seo: Page heads, a sitemap with hreflang, robots and a social card for every page
rows.docsSite: Documentation site on Fumadocs in every language, with search
rows.contentChecks: Checks that keep the docs in every language in step with English
rows.docsTranslations: The docs translated into every supported language
rows.auth: Better Auth: email verification, password reset, GitHub and Google sign-in, roles, and two-factor with backup codes
rows.rateLimits: Rate limiting on D1 for sign-in, server functions and emails
rows.authModules: Middleware, route guards and the auth modules with their use cases
rows.authPages: Sign-in, sign-up, verification, password reset and two-factor pages
rows.accountSettings: Account settings: password, two-factor and sessions for admins, and the time zone for every account
rows.admin: Admin console: dashboard, user table with its actions, settings
rows.email: Localized React Email templates sent through Resend
rows.unitTests: Unit, integration and component tests at {coverageThreshold, number}% code coverage
rows.browserTests: Playwright suites in Chromium and WebKit, with accessibility scans
